scope: Recovering curriculum and assignment drafts after concurrent writes or a lost write response in the primary interface
before: The API correctly rejected stale revisions and the editor preserved its draft, but teachers had no comparison or reconciliation action. Both new resolution tests failed against the previous production image because the comparison UI was absent.
implementation: Reusable three-way merge compares the last known baseline, the local draft and the freshly owned server snapshot without mutating inputs.

Independent object fields and stable-ID rows/tasks merge; overlapping fields require an explicit local/remote choice. Array insertions, deletions, reordering and overlapping unkeyed content blocks remain conservative whole-array choices.
A localized, keyboard-accessible comparison panel locks the editor while comparing, retries failed reads, preserves the draft on cancellation and confirms discarding all local changes.
Applying a merge changes only the editor. A subsequent explicit save still uses the compared server revision; another concurrent write causes another comparison rather than an overwrite.

If the merged result already matches the server, synchronizing the editor clears its dirty state and stale connection error without creating another version. This reconciles a write whose response was lost.
Assignment approval remains required after new edits; no merge automatically saves, approves or invokes AI.

verification.unit: 5 new merge tests passed; 92 total unit tests passed in the final production Docker build. Covers independent fields/tasks, explicit conflicts, deletions, structural ambiguity, equivalent object key ordering and prototype-safe JSON keys.
verification.chromium: 12 scenarios passed on the final image: 6 new comparison scenarios plus 6 existing delayed-read and acknowledged-save regressions.
verification.webkit: All 6 new comparison scenarios passed on the final image.
verification.realAPI: Tests use real synthetic accounts and database writes. They verify independent remote changes survive, a second write after comparison triggers safe re-resolution, failed comparison reads can retry, discard cancellation preserves the draft, and lost response recovery creates no extra revision.
verification.accessibilityAndLayout: Both comparison panels passed scoped axe and 360px overflow checks. Final mobile screenshots were visually inspected, with dark curriculum and light assignment comparisons. Task previews show content rather than internal block schema fields.
verification.build: Next.js production Docker image built successfully; final type checking, lint, formatting, source visibility, secret scan and diff whitespace checks passed.
verification.ci: The comparison spec was added to integration CI. A newly triggered remote run is not claimed successful by these local results.

remaining: Browser-close/crash draft recovery is not implemented by this change. Do not close an unsaved tab.
Lite still needs an equivalent reconciliation workflow.
Structural array conflicts require selecting an entire version of that list; identities are not inferred from matching positions or lengths.
Public deployment remains deferred by the owner and has not been performed.
